name: dsh-swarm
description: Local swarm mode for DeepSeek Harness, inspired by Google Antigravity /swarm: a lead splits a task into parallel workers (high) plus fresh verifiers (max) and a stall monitor (low), defaulting to opencode-go deepseek-v4.1-flash. In a Git repo each worker gets its own Git worktree and branch (DSH create_worktree) and the lead merges branches back. Includes the Swarm side pane (Board, Members, Graph, stall detection, coordinator context, session cost).
